sentences.text: Bridge of Spies is a 2015 historical drama legal thriller film directed and co-produced by Steven Spielberg , written by Matt Charman , Ethan and Joel Coen and stars Tom Hanks , Mark Rylance , Amy Ryan and Alan Alda .	Steven Spielberg	Steven Spielberg	Matt Charman	Matt Charman	Tom Hanks	Tom Hanks	Mark Rylance	Mark Rylance	Amy Ryan	Amy Ryan	Alan Alda	Alan Alda	historical drama	Historical period drama	legal thriller	legal thriller	Ethan and Joel Coen	Coen brothers

Set during the Cold War , the film tells the story of lawyer James B. Donovan , who is entrusted with negotiating the release of Francis Gary Powers -- a U.S. Air Force pilot whose U-2 spy plane was shot down over the Soviet Union in 1960 -- in exchange for Rudolf Abel , a convicted Soviet KGB spy held under the custody of the United States , whom he represented at trial . The name of the film refers to the Glienicke Bridge , which connects Potsdam with Berlin , where the prisoner exchange took place .	Glienicke Bridge	Glienicke Bridge	Potsdam	Potsdam	Berlin	Berlin
The film was an international co-production of the United States and Germany .	international co-production	international co-production	Germany	Germany
Bridge of Spies was shot under the working title of St. James Place .

Principal photography began on September 8 , 2014 , in Brooklyn , New York City , and the production proceeded at Babelsberg Studios in Potsdam .	Potsdam	Potsdam	Principal photography	Principal photography	Brooklyn	Brooklyn	New York City	New York City

The film was released by Touchstone Pictures on October 16 , 2015 , in the United States and distributed by 20th Century Fox in other territories .	Touchstone Pictures	Touchstone Pictures	20th Century Fox	20th Century Fox
It was a box office success , grossing $ 165 million worldwide , and received positive reviews , garnering praise for its direction , screenplay , acting , score , and production merits .

The film received six Academy Award nominations including Best Picture and Best Original Screenplay , and won Best Supporting Actor for Rylance .
